effects.display_name: Abyssal Axe native critical control/status package
effects.actual_behavior: CriticalHitEvent uses isVanillaCritical (not final critical result) and causing Player main-hand AbyssalAxe. Before any hurt-return success, target absolute velocity=(0,-1,0), attacker fallDistance=0, server attacker Regeneration8/4 and server victim Slowness10/5. Let delta=attacker axefallcheck-currentY. If delta>2 target and other server Living entities receive Wither30,int(20L+round(delta/3)); otherwise Wither30/20. Query is AABB inflate10 or inflate5 centered on ATTACKER event coordinates, includes all Entity types sorted by distance, excludes only attacker and direct victim. Each other entity receives absolute movement, with maxHP fallback -1 for nonliving: k=double(float(300F/(200F+maxHP)))/1.5; dx=centerX-recipientX,dz=centerZ-recipientZ. ++ uses(-dx*k,.3,-dz*k); -- uses(abs(dx)*k,.3,abs(dz)*k); +- uses(-dx*k,.3,abs(dz)*k); ELSE including either zero axis uses(abs(dx)*k,.3,-dz*k). There is NO clamp; do not reuse VoidRepulsion limits or flatten this to uniform outward knockback. Wither admission/addEffect is server Living-only; movement is all Entity without that guard. No native hurt, actual explosion, owner assignment, team, immunity, line-of-sight or hurt-result check is introduced; explosion particles/sound are presentation. axefallcheck producer remains queued with the weapon/state family.

effects.display_name: Arthropleura native linked segment damage transfer
effects.actual_behavior: Source-less incoming stores unrounded amount then requests anonymous segment0 for non-IN_WALL/non-segment body hits. Sourceful incoming body without marker and non-segment marks source arthropleura_target, cancels, stores round(amount), requests anonymous segment0, then marker20/0. Sourceful head without marker reissues originalSource50 only when amount>50 AND amount>=200 (preserve the literal negated <200), then segupwardstransfer1 and marker20/0. Body baseTick calls native reader when alive and segment number>0. Sorted inflate20 query links by UUID and ordinal: first segment copies current matching head health BEFORE forwarding positive stored amount as anonymous MOB_ATTACK(float(NBT)); head marker skips this forwarding. Predecessor segment receives stored NBT amount and source clears it BEFORE marker test; if admitted, fresh segment0 plus marker20/0. Successor receives upward flag when damage/upward pending; source upward flag clears BEFORE marker test, then segment0 if admitted. At end body loop BOTH pending fields reset0 even if matching target/marker prevented request. Head server/alive tick inflate10 finds matching first segment; upward flag transfers and clears before immunity check, then segment0/marker20. These are intermediate notifications, not extra independent damage parameters. No guaranteed exactly-once native receipt/transport is invented. Matching tame neighbor can transfer Player owner via tame. The global sourceful Arthropleura tame gate checks source and victim tame and owners nonnull, and compares victim owner with source owner. The decompiled source aid incorrectly repeats the source variable; exact native local9 versus local11 proves the actual distinct-actor comparison. Preserve native owner identity instead of general team equivalence. Segment resource is exhaustion.1,message_id segment,scaling never; no damage-type tag bypass inferred. Other segment motion, generation and lifecycle semantics remain queued.

effects.display_name: Native reactive Scarab actor/owner/color combat family
effects.actual_behavior: ScarabSummon extends TamableAnimal. baseTick calls parent,then native helper,then refreshDimensions; aiStep parent then swing update then setNoGravity(true). Helper health<=1 server-discard occurs first but does not return. EVERY call independently queues5 to set despawnable=true and350 to server-discard, with no alive/owner recheck; these repeated queues are native, not a new deduplicated lifetime. Untamed with Player in full-side15 tames to nearest Player, not an incoming-hit owner/flag-filtered Player. Tamed checks owner identity in inflate3; if absent and owner nonnull, absolute homing divides by unshifted three-dimensional owner distance, Y numerator adds.6, factor.3; no added zero-distance guard. First unlocked call sets variantlock=true BEFORE checking owner, so ownerless calls can lock none. Clears six synchronized found-color flags; only other tame same-owner Scarabs in inflate12.5 populate them. Separate foundotherscarab boolean tests ANY other entity same owner, but has no additional gameplay reader in this helper. Starts gold, sequentially downgrades through purple/iridescent/greengold/green/brown when owner color count<=0 OR matching color found OR Player matching sealed-item cooldown OR owner justsummoned-color false; final invalid brown server-discard. No reevaluation after lock. Tamed nonnull-owner count-sum<=0 server-discard. Query inflate7.5, owner Player identity only: native Resistance5/amps brown0,green1,greengold1,iridescent2,purple2,gold3 each call, no effect-applier argument/hurt-success check. Non-brown/non-green dashtime<=0: with target write absolute yaw motion(X divisor2,currentY,Z divisor8),then reset20 even without target;positive decrements1. Gold target Slow10/1 then self Strength10/1;purple target Slow10/0 then self Strength10/0;iridescent/green/greengold self Weakness10/0;brown self Weakness10/1, all server Living requests with flags false,false and ignored returns. Tamed nonnull-owner retarget<=0 resets50, scans all inflate5 sorted; each Mob targeting owner makes this Scarab target that Living mob, so last eligible sorted iterator wins, no added ally filter. Positive decrements1; dead current target cleared with native caught exception. Custom MOVE goal starts when target exists and move controller has no wanted position, continues while wanted+alive target. Start aims at target eye with speed1; tick intersecting bounding boxes calls inherited doHurtTarget EACH goal tick without local cooldown, return ignored;else squared distance<16 reissues eye chase speed1. Registered native OwnerHurtTargetGoal remains native team/admission. Attack-damage base3 is separate from color Strength/Weakness; other defense/motion bindings preserved, not silently Stage eligible. hurt ALWAYS calls server-discard helper BEFORE filtering direct ThrownPotion/AreaEffectCloud, NeoForge poison, FALL,DROWN,WITHER,WITHER_SKULL to false; remaining forwards unchanged source/amount to parent hurt. Thus rejected hurt still invokes discard; no immunity overrides that earlier callback. causeFallDamage false; no push collision; empty checkFallDamage. isFood tests empty List.of, so authored food-heal/tame interaction branches are unreachable; native spawn-egg and parent interaction remain, persistence requested only in nonfood paths. NBT saves/loads color and six found flags after parent owner state; raw persistent variantlock/clock state is not separately synchronized by these methods. Death tick20 removes KILLED/drops native experience (constructor reward0). Registry scarab_summon factory is the indexed Scarab constructor, dimensions.3/.3, registered attributes above. actual_behavior: BlazingFireBallEntity.onHitEntity invokes super then HitsLivingEntityProcedure regardless of hit success/Enderman early return inside super. Block callback invokes super then spawns FireArea at ball block position; if spawn succeeds, radius2 fire=true ExplosionInteraction.NONE explosion with new FireArea as source; discard independent. Flying-tick callback after super queries ALL entities in center box inflated.5 (full side1), excludes only BlazingFireBallEntity and calls igniteForSeconds3, no owner/LOS/hurt/impact-event gate. Authoritative server executes it; callback also runs client. Thus projectile veto may stop impact payload while proximity ignition remains distinct. Tick discards inGround. Do not couple any of these callbacks to arrow hurttrue.

FireArea is plain Entity, no stored owner. Registered dimensions3.5x.3. Server tick iterates Living touching its own BB, excludes fireImmune, requests ownerless minecraft:in_fire1.5, then independently igniteForSeconds4. Counter starts130, decrements until nonpositive discard; water/bubble discard; counter saved. Block-impact native explosion direct=FireArea, causing=null, minecraft:explosion (no ownership transfer from ball). Radius2 gives distance radius4; native exposure formula ((q*q+q)/2*7*4+1), q=(1-distance/4)*seenPercent, only native admitted entities/range/nonzero direction and calculator.shouldDamageEntity. Native ExplosionStart veto and Detonate list/event respected; native independent impulse/explosion-knockback resistance and event need separate fixture from hurtboolean. NONE means KEEP blocks, not zero HP or zero fire: finalizeExplosion fire loop remains, 1/3 at selected air over solid-render support, before ServerLevel clears toBlow for packet. Stage once final explosion hurt argument after exposure, not radius/exposure plus HP; FireArea1.5 separately once at its hurt call.

effects.human_summary: Ice Cluster native delayed freezing strike; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Both spike classes use IceSpikeEntity.canHurt: exclude resolved owner; exclude an OwnableEntity only when its ownerUUID is the SAME OBJECT as the spike UUID (reference comparison, not UUID.equals); require alive, nonspectator, not IceSpike or Cluster. No canFreeze, team or LOS test. First server baseTick applies Slowness20 ticks amplifier1 to admitted Living in its BB. At exact tickCount==delay, request ownerless freeze for stored damage, then independently set frozen200. Cluster additionally requires !held. Damage defaults10 and native helpers replace it. Normal spike dimensions1x1 scale .4/.6/.8/1; cluster2x2, held scale.1. Normal spike discards when prior spawn-animation counter==11; cluster when counter>=400+delay, with held state pausing activation/expiry. Damage occurs only at exact delay, not every contact tick. Scale each final freeze hurt request once.

Cluster hurt ignores damage amount/source and inherited HP: with zero hit-animation counter, remainingHit(default5)>1 decrements and starts an8-tick lockout; otherwise removes KILLED. Returns true on an admitted resource hit, false during lockout. Native ICE_GAUNTLET interaction with an available attachment slot0..3 stores the cluster UUID, starts use, sets held, transfers ownership to player and replaces remainingHit with the slot index. Holding shrinks its BB; it releases when the resolved ServerPlayer stops using. Equipment input/shooting remains later work. Spike/cluster save lowercase owner, delay, age and control/resource fields but NOT configured damage, which returns to10 on reload. A held cluster that misses exact delay does not replay its strike on release.

ServerPlayer release while secondary-use active and item cooldown absent computes held ticks i=72000-timeLeft; negative returns. Begins end animation, clips eye/view along blockInteractionRange*1.1 with COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE; MISS returns before cost. Pitch is clamped+/-85 only for wave direction after ray. Calls native iceWave range=min(i/32+.5,1.5)*12 (6..18), count=min(i,32), damage10,speed1, origin hit location. Cooldown80 and durability1 follow even if count0 or all candidate terrain rays reject. Protected helper places normal/cluster candidates, owner player, delays16+j, native stored damage10. No eye-to-each-spike LOS override or guaranteed count; normal versus cluster admitted HP/control/reload semantics remain R2i5b. Scale at later native spike/cluster hurt, never setDamage and hurt both.

LivingJumpEvent only ServerPlayer actively using exact gauntlet and no gauntlet cooldown; requires attachment !active and no stored shard UUID. Sets active, costs10durability, stops use, starts jump animation, cooldown400, Spatial push(view+Y2). LivingFallEvent ServerPlayer calls onFall; true cancels fall. PlayerFlyableFallEvent calls it without cancellation. onFall needs ONLY active flag, not continued equipment/use/cooldown; clears flag, starts landing animation, native iceBurst range8/count40/damage3, cluster random1/10 OR index<4, cooldown200. It also independently scans playerBB.inflate2 for any Entity except self, owner-matched OwnableEntity, dead/spectator, normal spike or cluster. Requests ownerless freeze10 then writes frozen200 regardless of hurt result; no Living/canFreeze/team/LOS guard. Passive freeze eligibility remains separate. Falling after item swap or native saved active state is a genuine fixture. Landing HP10 and delayed spikes are separate native payloads

effects.human_summary: Knight stack resource and hurt admission; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: hurt delegates processHurt(source,amount,false). If state dead OR source BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY with raw health-amount STRICTLY<0, delegate directly to super.hurt before bespoke cinematic/source/stack gates. Otherwise cinematictrue returnsfalse even for fromMark and exactly-lethal bypass. flag=fromMark OR bypass tag. flag skips server/UndeadCinematic<=0/exact-type exclusions(IN_FIRE,FALL,LIGHTNING_BOLT,WITHER,WITHER_SKULL), and skips the isInvulnerable stack branch. Ordinary sources must satisfy those filters; then if stacks>0 (or underlying invulnerable) only stuck-state branch can proceed. Non-stuck ordinary hit returnsfalse. All delegated hits still face native Entity/LivingEntity admission, incoming events, armor, Resistance, absorption and iframes; no Tensura/L2 bypass is proposed.

isInvulnerable returns stacks>0 OR base getter; removeOneImmuneStack simply subtracts1, no clamp. Ordinary admitted hit while state stuck removes one stack BEFORE hurt. If still invulnerable -> stagger; otherwise idle_to_knocked_down. Then super.hurt(source,min(20,amount*.1)) regardless eventual return. No positive-amount or successful-hurt requirement for stack removal in this branch. Therefore stack break and reduced HP attempt are distinct; a failed downstream hit can still consume a stack. Exact installed Entity.isInvulnerableTo checks backing invulnerable field rather than virtual isInvulnerable getter, so remaining Knight stacks do not by themselves cancel the delegated reduced hit. Source/event-based native rejection still applies.

End of heavy/light-heavy enters stuck ifisStuck then resetscounts, else stuck_to_idle. setState(stuck) creates native scale1 mark before base state transition. Thus genuine stack-opening opportunities come from actual native attacks; no forced-state prototype authorized.

effects.display_name: Kraken native tentacle smash and independent impulse
effects.human_summary: Kraken native tentacle smash and independent impulse; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Native tentacle registers heavy left/right goals priority1, light priority2, crate3 and runaway4. Melee requires MELEE type, target, random<.2, then owner absent OR owner neither knocked down nor at>=2 currently attacking tentacles, plus native hasLineOfSight. That method is a geometry predicate, not a block ray: same level, offset from tentacleY+7, absY<3, squared distance<=FOLLOW_RANGE^2(default24), yaw deviation<=targetRotationRange*factor. Crate uses distanceSquared<=FOLLOW_RANGE^2*1.5 and ignores height/yaw. Heavy factor.4, light.9, crate.8. These goals inherit requiresUpdateEveryTick=false; adjustedTickDelay is ceil(input/2). Heavy configured duration100/look20/hit40 becomes50/10/20 goal ticks; light75/20/36 becomes38/10/18; crate250/130 becomes125/65; runaway154/114 becomes77/57. Mob scheduler ordinarily ticks these every other server AI tick; report goal ticks, not guaranteed wall-time with unloaded/interrupted AI. Melee canContinue checks only timer, so losing target/knockdown after start does not cancel callback automatically. Crate additionally needs cached live target. Noninterruptible goals share MOVE/LOOK flags.

Light plane uses horizontal reach4, halfwidth2 and forward FOLLOW_RANGE; AABB from tentacleY+4 toY+10 inflated horizontally2. Victim position signed lateral distance must<=2; distanceModifier=(2-distance)/2. Heavy uses five colliders with (distance,side,size)=(1.05,.1,.4),(.6,.5,.4),(.9,.4,.4),(1.05,-.2,.4),(1.05,-.4,.2), scaled18*entityScale, Ycenter+7 and height6; left mirrors side offsets. It deduplicates each victim across boxes, keeps greatest modifier, combines impulse via cross product of normalized old/new vectors times average lengths (not simple addition). Targets are Living excluding all KrakenEntity/KrakenTentacleEntity and creative/spectator; no team or block LOS predicate at hit. Custom smash source direct tentacle, causing resolved Ownable owner (normally Kraken); amount=ATTACK_DAMAGE*maxDamageScale*clamp(modifier,.5,1), heavy1/light.5. Edge contact can still deal half-scale even when raw impulse modifier0. Hurt result ignored; Spatial push with projection limit1.5 follows independently. No enchantment post callback. Damage type bypasses armor/shield and suppresses normal damage knockback; independent Spatial push remains. Stage once at final native hurt, preserving original source.

effects.display_name: Kraken tentacle ownership, removal and respawn
effects.human_summary: Kraken tentacle ownership, removal and respawn; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Defined tentacles spawn server entities with owner UUID, ID/type/rotation, HP=max Kraken BASE maxHealth/12, armor/attack copied from base attributes, full tentacle HP. They are separate Monsters with parts. Cannon candidate creates a tentacle, chooses nearest Cannon within its BB.inflate32 that has no tentacle first passenger, and must successfully ride it; failure discards it and falls back to melee. Successful spawned UUIDs are tracked. Tentacle removal unconditionally calls owner.onTentacleDestroyed after resolving owner, with no RemovalReason or death-source filter. That callback removes UUID, increments deadTentacles server-side, summons pirates at cumulative count4 or6 OR removed type CANNON, and queues respawn for a matching current-phase definition. Thus discard/unload paths must be tested separately from HP defeat; never simplify callback to on-kill only. Phase0 delays by definition4800/6000/7200/8400; phase2 melee2400, cannon/crate2000. Queue sorted comparator uses respawnAtGameTime ONLY: equal timestamps compare equal even for different IDs. Per-ID duplicate check precedes add, but same-time distinct-ID add can still collapse. Retry spawn at/after deadline; remove timer if no current definition or spawn succeeds.

Tentacle native owner lookup refreshes server-side in baseTick and remove; Owner NBT capitalization matches on write/read. Type, ID and rotation persist; player targets/goals are not promoted from arbitrary NBT. On die, inherited die runs first; if dead, plays native type-specific death and leaves vehicle. tickDeath removes at>=115 server ticks, so phase resource/removal callbacks occur after the corpse delay. killQuietly is a native scripted direct setHealth0 then die(genericKill) when not dead; it does not route through hurt/IncomingDamage and has no Stage value. Parent death sequence uses it; no compat code is authorized to emulate it. Kraken removal only discards owned loaded tentacles for DISCARDED/KILLED, while tentacle removal itself is unfiltered. Loaded resolution and owner absence materially change resource outcomes.

Server tick iterates Living touching its own BB, excludes fireImmune, requests ownerless minecraft:in_fire1.5, then independently igniteForSeconds4. Counter starts130, decrements until nonpositive discard; water/bubble discard; counter saved. Block-impact native explosion direct=FireArea, causing=null, minecraft:explosion (no ownership transfer from ball). Radius2 gives distance radius4; native exposure formula ((q*q+q)/2*7*4+1), q=(1-distance/4)*seenPercent, only native admitted entities/range/nonzero direction and calculator.shouldDamageEntity. Native ExplosionStart veto and Detonate list/event respected; native independent impulse/explosion-knockback resistance and event need separate fixture from hurtboolean. NONE means KEEP blocks, not zero HP or zero fire: finalizeExplosion fire loop remains, 1/3 at selected air over solid-render support, before ServerLevel clears toBlow for packet. Stage once final explosion hurt argument after exposure, not radius/exposure plus HP; FireArea1.5 separately once at its hurt call.

ThrownCrate is native Projectile with gravity.05, drag.99 or.6 in water, swept COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE block ray plus eligible entity collision. Player-owner PvP rule, Neo ProjectileImpact veto and native hitTargetOrDeflectSelf precede hit callbacks. onHitEntity ignores every KrakenTentacleEntity and its part, doing no hit damage/explosion/discard for those results. Other entity result: unless exact owner, requests ownerless magic2; hurttrue and server gates enchantment post callback. Independently server explodes radius1.5/firefalse/MOB, drops2 Cannonball items and discards, even when hurtfalse or owner-equality prevented direct damage. Block impact also explodes/drops/discards. Dropped ammunition is combat supply, not another HP effect. Ordinary projectile ownership rejection may preclude owner hit, but callback semantics are preserved rather than fabricating that test.

Native Explosion resolves indirect source from Projectile owner when it is Living. DamageSources.explosion selects player_explosion whenever BOTH direct and causing entities are nonnull, regardless of whether causing entity is a Player. Therefore native crate explosion is normally direct crate/causing tentacle/player_explosion; cannon explosion is direct cannonball/causing Player/player_explosion. When owner is genuinely unresolved/nonliving it becomes explosion with null causing entity. The exact EXPLOSION-only branch in Cannonball.hasCausedDamage therefore does NOT match normal player-fired cannon splash. Its custom impact still gets native Kraken/tentacle5 multiplier. Owned crate explosion also is not cannon damage. Do not re-label source to make a presumed weakness work. Both explosion types carry is_explosion/no_knockback, bypass neither armor nor shield, and retain normal event/Resistance/protection rules.

Crate radius1.5 and cannon radius2 use native MOB explosion admission, start/detonate hooks, exposure/block occlusion and difficulty. For damage diameter=2*radius, impact=(1-distance/diameter)*exposure; native requested HP=int((impact*impact+impact)/2*7*diameter+1) when native calculator permits, rather than a fixed projectile amount. Radius/exposure also determine affected entities and motion Native explosion impulse is separate from hurt result and normal no_knockback tag, with native blast/knockback reduction and player motion handling. MOB block interaction follows griefing rules; keep it native. Veto of direct impact HP is not veto of explosion. Two HP channels may meet native cooldown/iframes; no promise that nominal amounts add at runtime.

Cannonball shares swept projectile/PvP/Neo-impact/deflection handling with crate. Special findHitEntity first searches nearest Kraken within16 using noncombat targeting/ignoreLineOfSight; if projectile currently overlaps that Kraken box it returns Kraken entity hit, otherwise ordinary swept predicate. This is not an unconditional16-range hit and hidden0x0/source admission remain relevant. onHitEntity exact-owner result skips custom hurt AND explosion/discard. Other target requests custom cannonball_hit10 direct ball/causing owner; hurttrue server gates enchantment post; independent radius2 MOB explosion then discard even if hurtfalse. Block hit only explosion/discard. No speed*base arrow damage here. Stage final custom10 and explosion HP separately, exactly once per native request.

Chest Post branch independently passes Math.random<=.1, requires direct DamageSource entity instanceof Projectile, uses projectile.owner when nonnull else source.causing entity, requires nonnull cause and cause.distanceTo(wearer)>=3. onPlayerHurt is LivingDamageEvent.Post for ServerPlayer. Checks exact equipped boots first then chest. No event amount>0, source-is-fall, cooldown or recursive guard in handler. Do not turn a synthetic event into a delivered path. Native runtime fixtures must use genuine admitted incoming hits and record actual Post/result ordering.

Boots require fallDistance>=3 and max(knownMovement dot down, deltaMovement dot down)>=.5. Radius clamps that downward speed to[0,4.5]. Thus normally two damage/detonate/control passes, one finalization. Source is player_explosion with direct/causing wearer; NONE keeps blocks and fire flag isfalse. Native hurt cooldowns/geometry may suppress repeat HP: do not assert doubled HP. actual_behavior: SpatialUtil.pushEntity computes additive raw force. With speedLimit>=0, project newMotion=(current+force) onto normalized force; if projection>limit replace force with normalized newMotion*limit, then target.push(force). Generic roll has no blanket push veto; only concrete payloads such as already-indexed GlacialShove add one.

This rejects application/refresh through those paths, not removal or cleansing existing effects and not arbitrary instant-effect functions/healing. Later event listeners can change final result; Tensura/L2 ordering remains future runtime work.

Player cannot also be Projectile, so this branch cannot cancel ordinary native projectile impacts. Do not promote it as projectile deflection/impact immunity. Damage/effect cancellation may still reject later callbacks, while independent explosions, motion, summons, discard or hurt-ignored callbacks can proceed; each payload family must retain its native return dependencies.

Shared AbstractStateBoss lethal restoration runs after normal actual damage/Post and excludes BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. This terminal request is scripted, not a scalable combat payload; normal native rejection/mitigation remains relevant.

Native StateGoal ticks the controller every AI tick. ActiveState starts timer-1, increments then runs onStart at0 and onTick. onTickFor calls its callback before ending at timer>=limit; endAfter ends at>=limit. Stack push adds first; StateSequence pushes its next child and ticks it immediately. Controller ends an END result only when the original state is still first. This proves real attack delivery without invoking helpers directly. Server animation positions feed multipart boxes and attack bone lines. Intro, warnings, camera shake and death particles carry no extra damage. Patrol dive/emerge can also execute the same native strike callbacks before phase0; they are not silently treated as combat-phase-only.

effects.human_summary: Sandworm multipart damage and retaliation resource; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Sixteen native parts use server animation bone positions; part0 dimensions4.5x4.5, others4x4. Parent ordinary hurt rejects client and routes to part1. Part hurt forwards original source to parent and does not apply a second HP pipeline. Sandworm part overload first multiplies incoming amount by1.3 if that segment bit is damaged, rejects result<.01, then invokes inherited hurt through reallyHurt. Only a true result accumulates max(previousHP-currentHP,0) into one GLOBAL recentDamage resource, not one per segment. At>=25 it damages the currently hit segment and resets resource0; otherwise sets reset timer60. Server timer expiry clears the resource. Threshold uses actual net HP loss, including shared lethal restoration. Already-damaged segments can consume another25 threshold; no extra armor stack.

After successful inherited hurt and segment update, damaged current segment plus source.isDirect plus absence of BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY launches spit from that part toward source.directEntity. DamageSource.isDirect means causingEntity==directEntity, including null==null; it is NOT a physical DamageType test and does not require a Living attacker. Thus an admitted ownerless environmental source can launch untargeted retaliation. A normal owned arrow has different direct/causing entities and fails this condition. A hit that first breaks a segment can immediately retaliate. Hurt false does neither accumulation nor retaliation. Preserve source identity and native event ordering.

actual_behavior: attackEntity(target,damageScale) selects native mobAttack(this), whose direct and causing entities are the boss. Hurtfalse returns false; hurttrue runs native server post-attack enchantments, records lastHurtMob, returns true. No hardcoded universal damage amount, no source substitution and no owner-to-player rewrite. never multiply both attribute and helper or concrete caller and helper.

meleeAttack uses LivingEntity query in AABB.ofSize(position+getLookOffset(reach),aabbSize,aabbSize,aabbSize), excluding self. Default offset height1.5; size is full side length, not radius. Shared helper adds no LOS, team/owner, attackable, current-target-only or native TargetingConditions predicate; callers may choose their own predicates separately. For each selected entity, attackEntity success is required before raw outward normalized horizontal push*pushForce (Y=.2) and consumer callback. Hurtfalse prevents both these followups. Caller-specific damageScale, box, timing and callbacks remain next; no geometric inflation/eligibility repair.

Knight server tick executes attacks only outside animation transition. Its MeleeAttackGoal.canPerformAttack override returnsfalse, so no extra ordinary AI melee is invented for the boss. Actual producers are tick melee/SwordWave/Rift plus jumpSlash->SoulShockwave. attackCombo1 is genuinely called; older attackJumpspin1 has zero installed invocation callers, so its17.5base shockwave is excluded. SoulShockwave static convenience shoot overloads have no external native static callers; do not invent a player delivery. SwordWave also has a real KnightSwordItem.releaseUsing producer, reserved for equipment review using this payload contract.

All native boss melee uses protected shared helper: final damageScale*ATTACK_DAMAGE then native enchantment damage, mob_attack boss/boss, hurttrue required for outward push and consumer. Preserve this expression, do not reinterpret as a conventional centered half-angle cone. No LOS check. Source is mob_attack, direct and causing entity Yeti; shared helper computes current ATTACK_DAMAGE*scale then native enchantment modification. Scale only its final hurt amount.

Damage cancellation need not cancel these controls/effects.

attackCollidingEntities collects Living targets in each line AABB inflated(maxDistance+2), excludes self and creative/spectator, with no team or LOS check. Projects victim box center onto each finite line. Modifier=1-max((distanceFromLine-2)/maxDistance,0); only positive values, at most1. Each invocation deduplicates by victim and keeps greatest modifier across lines. Boolean is ignored and optional effect/control callback always follows. Scale only the final native hurt amount once, never both parent/helper or raw attribute. Ordinary body contact selects greatest part overlap, then pushes server nonplayers or client players via XOR side predicate, projection limit.3; no HP payload from passive contact.

effects.human_summary: Native boss lethal-hit choreography; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Exact NeoForge LivingEntity.actuallyHurt performs native armor/magic/Pre/absorption processing; when final newDamage!=0, records damage, setHealth(oldHP-newDamage), game event, then virtual onDamageTaken. Only afterward calls CommonHooks.onLivingDamagePost. AbstractBossEntity.onDamageTaken invokes maybeCancelDeath: require deadOrDying, source NOT BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY, shouldCancelDeath true; if still dead, setHealth(.1), then BossCancelDieProcedure. Base shouldCancelDeath always sets state dead and returns whether prior state was not dead. This is native conditional death choreography, not heal/event amount replacement. Subclasses override decision (pending exact family semantics). Post listeners can observe already-restoredHP while reported damage remains unchanged; no measured-HP-loss equivalence assumed.

AbstractStateBossEntity overrides actuallyHurt: call super.actuallyHurt completely (including native Post callback), then maybeCancelDeath(source). Same dead/non-bypass/shouldCancelDeath predicates and .1 restoration, followed by cancelDeath. Base shouldCancelDeath=false and cancelDeath empty; only real subclass overrides enable it. Thus state bosses perform this restoration AFTER Post while legacy bosses do it BEFORE Post. Neither is an unconditional boss immunity or ordinary heal. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY skips this shared choreography, subject to the concrete boss own hurt admission. Do not scale .1 restoration or intercepted death-state duration.

Both getSourceEntity methods try stored SourceUUID lookup in ServerLevel and require LivingEntity; on missing/invalid/nonliving use current Living target else self. AbstractStateBossEntity.simulatePlayerKill creates ordinary PLAYER_ATTACK source with that resolved entity in the single-entity constructor (direct=causing resolved entity, not necessarily a Player), requests999 against self, ignores hurt result. Actual callers are Kraken two state lambdas and Sandworm one state lambda, with exact state gating pending respective review. This is native defeat scripting, NO_STAGE_VALUE, not a proposed fallback damage implementation. Native source tags/admission and callbacks still apply.

Non-AbstractArrow projectile sources receive no .15 modifier solely because of is_projectile tag. Preserve original source

Values13..1 allow calls without restarting counter. Counter marker read by renderer is cosmetic, not separate admission rule. No hitboolean gate protects these writes. Legacy spawn counter default0 guarded separately; do not synthesize a positive counter as ordinary delivery.

Preserve native duration/counts; actual world-scheduler delivery and concrete suppliers remain family review.

actual_behavior: DamageMemory.afterDamage records only result==true AND source.getEntity()!=null AND requested amount>4 (strict); it stores that original request, source object and entity.tickCount. Installed Lich/Gauntlet capacity5, Obsidilith/VoidBlossom10; CerbonsAPI adds newest and removes oldest on overflow. Do not multiply the history amount separately or invent owners for null causing entities.

TargetSwitcher consumes this history: causing attacker must be LivingEntity, sensed LOS, strict distanceSquared<FOLLOW_RANGE squared, entity.canAttack true, and ageWhenDamaged+600>=current tick. Group by causing entity, sum recorded requested amounts, choose maximum; if selected target differs and random.nextInt(2)==0, set target. No damage is created and no unconditional player rewrite occurs. Whole-JAR calls from Lich/Obsidilith/Gauntlet/VoidBlossom move logic are indexed; their scheduling remains family review. DamagedAttackerNotSeen separately invokes its callback when current target null and causing entity Living, regardless hurt result, with no LOS test despite its name. effects.closest_vanilla_equivalent: CUSTOM_CONTROL; exact native callbacks retained.
vanilla_similarities: Native damage/effect/heal/source pipeline where delegated.
vanilla_differences: DamageMemory.afterDamage records only result==true AND source.getEntity()!=null AND requested amount>4 (strict); it stores that original request, source object and entity.tickCount. It does not measure final HP loss, absorption, resistance or actual damage events. Its initial history item is amount0/fellOutOfWorld/age0 and is not an attack. Installed Lich/Gauntlet capacity5, Obsidilith/VoidBlossom10; CerbonsAPI adds newest and removes oldest on overflow. Do not multiply the history amount separately or invent owners for null causing entities.

TargetSwitcher consumes this history: causing attacker must be LivingEntity, sensed LOS, strict distanceSquared<FOLLOW_RANGE squared, entity.canAttack true, and ageWhenDamaged+600>=current tick. Group by causing entity, sum recorded requested amounts, choose maximum; if selected target differs and random.nextInt(2)==0, set target. No damage is created and no unconditional player rewrite occurs. Whole-JAR calls from Lich/Obsidilith/Gauntlet/VoidBlossom move logic are indexed; their scheduling remains family review. DamagedAttackerNotSeen separately invokes its callback when current target null and causing entity Living, regardless hurt result, with no LOS test despite its name. Installed Lich callback further requires ServerPlayer before teleport action; teleport eligibility is next.

effects.display_name: Native Holder/value effect filter and external admission
effects.human_summary: Native Holder/value effect filter and external admission; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Exactly two installed constructors create EffectsImmunity: Obsidilith and Gauntlet, passing MobEffects.WITHER.value() and POISON.value() into a MobEffect array. The filter stores Arrays.asList(values) but canBeAffected calls !list.contains(effect.getEffect()). Patched MobEffectInstance.getEffect returns Holder. Arrays$ArrayList.indexOf compares the supplied holder via equals to each stored MobEffect. Patched Holder.Reference.equals requires identity or another Holder of reference kind with the same key; the MobEffect value is neither. Therefore these ordinary registered effects are NOT excluded by this filter, including Poison and Wither. The code never unwraps the candidate holder. This is a proven native Holder/value mismatch, not an intended immunity to preserve by inference. BaseEntity uses this filter result directly, bypassing its super.canBeAffected fallback while configured. No repair is implemented or authorized.

The filter mismatch is not an unconditional force-apply bypass. Patched LivingEntity.addEffect calls CommonHooks.canMobEffectBeApplied before inserting/updating an effect. That posts NeoForge MobEffectEvent.Applicable; APPLY admits, DEFAULT calls virtual canBeAffected, DO_NOT_APPLY rejects. Tensura/L2 or other listeners may still reject through this path. Native parent tag checks (immune_to_infested, immune_to_oozing, ignores_poison_and_regen) are in the superclass branch and are skipped by configured filter delegation; actual pack tags/traits are runtime fixture work. Other two bosses have no installed EffectsImmunity constructor here and inherit the fallback unless their own family changes admission.

effects.human_summary: Native Resistance and Slow Falling; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Living current owner gets Resistance120amp1 and SlowFalling20amp0 via independent addEffect calls without source entity. Then query all Living in impact AABB inflate6, no owner/team/LOS exclusion. XZ accepts center distanceSquared<9 OR horizontal radius3 point contained in victim box inflatedY10. Y predicate is literally maxY>impactY-1 OR minY<impactY+3, not AND; for ordinary ordered boxes this does not provide the intended interval rejection. The outer6 AABB still bounds query. Native knockback.4 uses impact-minus-victim X/Z (push away), including potentially just-teleported owner; preserves vanilla knockback Resistance and NeoForge hook. Independent of zero hurt result and effect admission. Native Resistance amp1 contributes40% reduction when neither BYPASSES_EFFECTS nor BYPASSES_RESISTANCE, amp0 contributes20%; SlowFalling descending gravity is min(nativeGravity,.01).

Registered CrystalFruit properties supply always-edible food: each native server addEatEffect probability1 requests Regeneration300amp1, Heal1amp0, Resistance600amp0. Native Player.eat delegates LivingEntity.eat -> addEatEffect -> addEffect; no custom finishUsingItem or direct HP subtraction. Normal consumption/effect applicability and existing-effect merging remain. The Heal effect is added as a one-tick status; it follows HealOrHarmMobEffect.applyEffectTick, not the potion applyInstantenousEffect source form. Ordinary nutrition/saturation and acquisition excluded.

effects.human_summary: Native Gauntlet eye/source-direction admission; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: GauntletHitboxes.shouldDamage captures nextDamagedPart then clears it for EVERY attempt. If MiscUtils.isModLoaded(bettercombat) OR epicfight at helper initialization, returntrue from this handler. Otherwise eye part OR BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY passes. For null/non-eye part and no bypass, IS_EXPLOSION also passes when nonnull source.getSourcePosition yields vector(sourcePos->GauntletEye) with dot(lookAngle)<=0; perpendicular boundary is included. DamageSource.getSourcePosition uses explicit source position, otherwise direct entity current position, otherwise null; it is not necessarily the explosion center. This is a front-side source-position test, not a shield_piercing exemption or a per-victim amount cap. Remaining cases reject; nonprojectile causing Living attacker receives native knockback.5, fire-tagged sources only suppress clink sound. Earlier shared before/after hooks remain and remaining native super.hurt admission applies. The compatibility toggle does not disable every native defense.

Open-hand native EntityBounds includes eye and fingers/thumb/pinky/root shapes. Closed fist has rootFist/rootFistYaw and NO eye. Geometry follows entity yaw/pitch/position; setOpenHandHitbox/setClosedFistHitbox sends native ChangeHitboxS2C. Thus genuine closed-fist geometry cannot supply an eye part, but invulnerability bypass/front explosion/compatibility-toggle rules still apply. GauntletClientEnergyShieldHandler only renders isEnergized particles/alpha; it is not a separate damage shield or charge resource. Preserve actual part selection rather than setting eye by a harness shortcut.

Required CerbonsAPI ProjectileMixin injects at Projectile.onHit HEAD. On EntityHitResult whose victim is MultipartAwareEntity, it raycasts victim.getBounds from projectile.position to position+deltaMovement and passes the returned part string to setNextDamagedPart. EntityBounds.raycast chooses the nearest intersecting named part. It does not fabricate a DamageSource or multiply amount. Genuine vanilla projectile impact/deflection/cancellation and projectile-specific superclass calls must reach this hook; a raw target.hurt call does not supply a part. Missing ray hit writesnull; consumed field does not grant persistent eye admission.

Client MultiPlayerGameMode attack HEAD raycasts camera eye/view to ENTITY_INTERACTION_RANGE. If nonnull part, sends native MultipartEntityInteractionC2SPacket; nonspectator locally sets part, attacks and resets attack ticker, cancels original client method. Server packet requires nonclient side and sender, resolves entity id, writes native part through MultipartAwareEntity and calls ServerPlayer.attack(entity). It does not directly subtract HP or create substitute damage. The pinned packet body does not perform its own server raycast/reach check; research fixtures must use genuine native ray/packet delivery, not inject a part. Ordinary non-multipart/generic attack callbacks are separate missing-part fixtures. Runtime mixin application/packet registration still needs observation.

actual_behavior: GauntletGoalHandler starts isAggroed=false; its afterDamage activates goals only on hurt resulttrue, once, and writes/loads isAggroed NBT. Rejected body attempts do not wake it. effects.display_name: Native lagged laser geometry and phase sequence
effects.human_summary: Native lagged laser geometry and phase sequence; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Laser captures a Living target, builds HistoricalData(Vec3.ZERO,8), then EventSeries: delay25 start target-id sync;60 updates of position recording/application; final uncancelled stop clears history/id and emits stop event. EventSeries advances through removed/canceled members and preserves final cleanup, not parallel scheduling. After seven captured positions, list size first reaches8 and oldest is still initial Vec3.ZERO, so first application aims along that direction; thereafter oldest is a lagged target center. At most54 applications in an uncanceled60-update recording stage; no claim of54 hits. Extend eye->selected position to length30, block clip COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE truncates beam to hit location; every even boss tick attempts tiny-AABB native block clearing. FindEntitiesInLine uses segment AABB and each candidate bounding-box clip, excludes boss, then selects Living; no extra team/current-target-only filter. Native helper damage/cooldown repeats determine actual HP loss.

Despite destroyBlocks name, installed helper destroys ONLY nonair block equal to Blocks.FIRE, with mobGriefing true and not WITHER_IMMUNE. It does not clear stone or general cover, or soul fire. Laser therefore does not tunnel through ordinary solid cover via this helper. This binary native gate is relevant to delivery; no worldgen/utility archaeology or bypass is proposed.

actual_behavior: Comet uses the same native owner/exemption/delivery helper but deals no separate entity-impact HP hit. Entity hit, block hit, or CometProjectile.hurt calls onImpact. onImpact first checks and sets impacted=true; then if CURRENT owner Living, invokes nonnull captured impactAction at projectile.position and discards. Missing/nonliving owner sets impacted with no callback and no discard in this branch. Default/load constructor has null callback. hurt invokes onImpact BEFORE super.hurt and returns the superclass result: explosion is not conditional on attack damage being accepted, and onImpact has no independent server guard (natural collision delivery is server-gated by the base). This is detonation, not a native reflection mechanic.

Both CometAction constructors capture the creating Lich in their explosion callback: level.explode(lich,x,y,z,config.comet.explosionStrength,ExplosionInteraction.MOB), default fire=false. Installed strength4. Native explosion direct source is that captured Lich and indirect source is the same Living Lich, selecting minecraft:player_explosion even though the attacker is a mob. The comet projectile and the entity that hurt it are neither direct nor causing explosion source. Owner changes alone would not rewrite the captured callback. Do not fabricate PLAYER identity from the DamageType name. A native source exclusion keeps the Lich out of the initial explosion candidate list, subject to later event-list modifications.

Native explosion selects within radius2*strength, permits ignoreExplosion and damage-calculator admission, checks nonzero directional length, posts NeoForge detonation hooks, then calls victim.hurt with calculator amount. Default amount: ((exposure*(1-distance/(2*strength)))^2 + exposure*(1-distance/(2*strength)))/2 *7*(2*strength)+1. Native exposure and geometry remain; damage hurt return is ignored and explosion displacement proceeds independently with native EXPLOSION_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE and EventHooks.getExplosionKnockback. Monolith ExplosionMixin may change supplied strength and is pending equipment review. do not scale strength/radius, exposure, knockback or both callback and explosion engine.

Ordinary comet requires ServerPlayer at scheduling, launches once at delay60 through ThrowProjectileAction, which uses whatever nonnull current target exists at execution; cooldown80. No falling-block/anvil DamageSource is produced. Because Event executes before removal and its condition ignores alive, an already-enqueued landing event can detonate if both landing condition and death are true in the same update. effects.closest_vanilla_equivalent: VANILLA_LIKE_EXTENDED; exact native callbacks retained.
vanilla_similarities: Native damage/effect/heal/source pipeline where delegated.
vanilla_differences: Comet uses the same native owner/exemption/delivery helper but deals no separate entity-impact HP hit. Entity hit, block hit, or CometProjectile.hurt calls onImpact. onImpact first checks and sets impacted=true; then if CURRENT owner Living, invokes nonnull captured impactAction at projectile.position and discards. Missing/nonliving owner sets impacted with no callback and no discard in this branch. Default/load constructor has null callback. hurt invokes onImpact BEFORE super.hurt and returns the superclass result: explosion is not conditional on attack damage being accepted, and onImpact has no independent server guard (natural collision delivery is server-gated by the base). This is detonation, not a native reflection mechanic.

Both CometAction constructors capture the creating Lich in their explosion callback: level.explode(lich,x,y,z,config.comet.explosionStrength,ExplosionInteraction.MOB), default fire=false. Installed strength4. Native explosion direct source is that captured Lich and indirect source is the same Living Lich, selecting minecraft:player_explosion even though the attacker is a mob. The comet projectile and the entity that hurt it are neither direct nor causing explosion source. Owner changes alone would not rewrite the captured callback. Do not fabricate PLAYER identity from the DamageType name. A native source exclusion keeps the Lich out of the initial explosion candidate list, subject to later event-list modifications.

Native explosion selects within radius2*strength, permits ignoreExplosion and damage-calculator admission, checks nonzero directional length, posts NeoForge detonation hooks, then calls victim.hurt with calculator amount. Default amount: ((exposure*(1-distance/(2*strength)))^2 + exposure*(1-distance/(2*strength)))/2 *7*(2*strength)+1. Native exposure and geometry remain; damage hurt return is ignored and explosion displacement proceeds independently with native EXPLOSION_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE and EventHooks.getExplosionKnockback. Monolith ExplosionMixin may change supplied strength and is pending equipment review. do not scale strength/radius, exposure, knockback or both callback and explosion engine.

Ordinary comet requires ServerPlayer at scheduling, launches once at delay60 through ThrowProjectileAction, which uses whatever nonnull current target exists at execution; cooldown80. Rage captures ServerPlayer, emits six comet creations at delays60+30*i, i0..5, from a six-point radius3 ring and aims at captured player current center; return duration240. Entity-hit, block-hit and projectile-hurt detonation are distinct runtime entry paths. Prevent duplicate damage by retaining impacted flag; never add an entity-impact fallback.

AnvilAction server path captures current target object and after20, if actor alive, reads target.position, remembers original boss pos and moveTo target+Y24. After another delay1, if alive, enqueue Event whose condition is onGround OR Y<0, removal is dead OR condition. If condition true it explodes at boss current position with actor source, configured strength4, MOB, then queues return to saved originalPos after20 canceled if boss dead. No falling-block/anvil DamageSource is produced. Because Event executes before removal and its condition ignores alive, an already-enqueued landing event can detonate if both landing condition and death are true in the same update. No extra immediate HP attack is hidden in relocation.

If spawnPillarOnDeath=true (installed), Obsidilith.die invokes onDeath before super.die. Server onDeath creates native actor-centered explosion strength2/MOB/firefalse, then schedules obsidian pillar construction and loot/experience (brief exclusion after the combat explosion). Both anvil and death explosions use direct=causing Obsidilith and thus minecraft:player_explosion, independent of hurt success. Reuse R2j3 native exposure/mitigation/independent explosion vector; Monolith may alter strength in its pending equipment hook. Config false prevents this native death branch. Source actor is excluded from initial explosion candidate list, external event changes remain possible.

Punch captures target-based overshoot point, attempts native block clear, pushes bossY+.7. Close fist delay7, accelerate from16 for15 updates (.6 first then.32, stop near target squared distance<9 or cancel), active impact from16 for40 updates, stop animation56, reopen64 without cancellation. Each active callback tests block collision then entity overlap then records current speed as previousSpeed; previousSpeed field persists between moves. Collision horizontal/vertical AND previousSpeed>.55 requests actor-source native explosion strength(previousSpeed*normalPunchExplosionMultiplier), installed multiplier1.5. No once-per-punch explosion flag. Entity impact queries Living entities in current native bounding box excluding boss only, calls Mob.doHurtTarget then unconditionally target.addDeltaMovement(bossVelocity*.5), even on hurtfalse. No target-only/team/LOS predicate or per-target hit cache.

Swirl sets isEnergized=true and bossY+.7, closes fist7, accelerates30 for15 updates (.6 then.4), active impact30 for30, reopens60 and clears energized without cancellation. Entity contact uses same native melee and independent extra velocity. First qualifying block collision while energized requests actor-source explosion configured4.5 with fire=true, then clears energized; later collisions use speed*1.5 firefalse. actual_behavior: ProjectileThrower creates the native projectile with constructor owner, computes target-current position, adds horizontal-distance*.2 vertical compensation, shoots speed1.6/divergence0 and adds it to the level. Inherited ThrowableProjectile checks native ray hit and NeoForge onProjectileImpact cancellation before hitTargetOrDeflectSelf. A native non-NONE target deflection suppresses onHit; default self-deflection forwards the CURRENT owner, not automatically the defender. BaseThrownItemProjectile.onHit further requires server side, then entityCollisionPredicate. ExemptEntities rejects by exact entity TYPE; Lich missiles/comets exempt minecraft:phantom, including unrelated wild Phantoms. Inherited canHitEntity and owner/vehicle-leftOwner rules remain. No extra LOS/team/current-target-only or Tensura eligibility is invented.

Native entity id bosses_of_mass_destruction:blue_fireball is MagicMissileProjectile, despite its name. On admitted entityHit: current getOwner must be LivingEntity; request owner current ATTACK_DAMAGE with native damageSources.thrown(this,owner), direct missile/causing current owner. It ignores hurt return, then invokes its nonnull LivingEntity callback, then discards unconditionally, including missing/nonliving-owner cases. No post-attack enchantment or ignition callback exists in this body. Actual source is minecraft:thrown, not magic, fire or shield_piercing. never multiply both attribute and hit.

SporeAction requires ServerPlayer, after45 throws one native SporeBall from boss eye toward captured target eye with speed.75, divergence0, gravity compensation.2. Constructor exempts ALL VoidBlossom entity types from entityHit through ExemptEntities. BaseThrownItemProjectile calls native superclass onHit then gated entityHit; Spore overrides outer collision predicate totrue on both sides. Entity contact on server requires current owner Living and victim!=owner, requests minecraft:thrown(direct ball, causing current owner), amount current owner ATTACK_DAMAGE, discards boolean. It does NOT latch impacted, call onImpact, discard, poison or start burst. Native projectile collision/deflection still applies; it can continue and encounter blocks later.

BladeAction requires ServerPlayer; three callbacks after28/52/75 each aim11 native PetalBlade projectiles across a target-center line of halfwidth7 with random-sign20-degree rotation. Maximum33 creations if uncanceled, not33 hits. Speed.9, noGravitytrue, owner boss, exempts boss entity TYPE. Native entity hit with current owner Living requests minecraft:thrown(direct blade, causing currentowner), currentowner attack12; then supplied callback runs on Living victim regardless hurtboolean (this boss supplies EMPTY callback); discard always follows, including missing/nonliving owner. Block callback calls superclass then discards. No native hurt override that provides player reflection; retain engine deflection/ownership semantics without inventing one. Predicate/callback fields and spore impacted are not explicitly serialized by these classes; later native save/load fixture must compare reconstructed default constructor state with launched state.

effects.display_name: Native rune resource and shield admission
effects.human_summary: Native rune resource and shield admission; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: Synced isShielded initially false. Native resource is activePillars, an append-only-until-cleanup list of BlockPos, not hit count or HP. RuneBlock.onPlace schedules its native block tick after10; that tick links itself to EVERY Obsidilith in AABB(pos).inflate(15,40,15), by addActivePillar with no owner test or deduplication. Each boss serverTick removes positions whose block is no longer OBSIDILITH_RUNE OR whose BlockPos is not strictly closerThan boss.blockPosition,64, then sets shield to list nonempty. effects.human_summary: Native world rift repeat/cancellation contract; static native semantics, runtime untested.
actual_behavior: These attacks use CapabilityUtils -> installed NeoForgeCapabilityHelper -> LevelEventScheduler.get(level), not the boss preTick queue. Installed @SubscribeEvent LevelTickEvent.Post updates that scheduler. Server storage is per-level SavedData with lazily allocated EventScheduler, but save returns the supplied tag unchanged and queued events are not serialized. Boss death does not itself destroy the world queue; each callback supplier controls cancellation. General Event.shouldDoEvent reads condition only; shouldRemoveEvent reads cancellation. Shared scheduler executes eligible callback before checking removal, so condition and cancellation true in the same update can still run the callback. No runtime dispatch is claimed from annotations alone.

RiftBurst default placement begins14 blocks above requested point, finds sturdy upward FULL support down to min build height, chooses ground.above, requires upY+28>=aboveY and replaceability using DirectionalPlaceContext. On placement schedule indicator wait riftTime, cancel while original block no longer replaceable OR actor dead. Once that event executes, it queues inner TimedEvent(delay0,duration7,cancel=false). For seven updates it queries LivingEntity in one-block AABB at pos+(0,2*k,0), k0..6, excludes only exact actor and calls onImpact for each. No LOS/team/owner/canAttack/target-only filter or per-target deduplication is added. Adjacent tiles, height intersections and later waves can attempt repeated hits; native hurt cooldown/admission determines HP progress. Once inner queue begins, actor death or loss of target/open block does not cancel it.

effects.display_name: Blazing Brand armor/toughness reduction and native delivery
effects.actual_behavior: Blazing Brand is harmful: armor and toughness each receive -.2*(amp+1) ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL under distinct IDs. Its tick returns true and does no damage/fire. Fire ignition or healing alongside some application sites belongs to those producers, not a Brand DOT. The separate critical-hit producer is referenced by global_gear_critical_brand_admission; it is not a Brand tick/modifier primitive. Brand and Wetness stacking methods first call removeEffectNoUpdate on an existing effect, then request a new effect through normal addEffect. Raw removal directly deletes the map entry and skips EventHooks.onEffectRemoved/onEffectRemoved attribute cleanup. On successful replacement, native onEffectAdded removes/replaces the same modifier IDs. If addEffect rejects, old modifier cleanup was skipped and the removed effect is no longer available for ordinary expiry cleanup: stale native armor/speed modifiers are a concrete future fixture concern. Preserve the native sequence; no silent cleanup or eligibility bypass. Regular nonstacking applications retain native merge/update semantics.

effects.display_name: Curse of Desert native client input control
effects.actual_behavior: Curse of Desert has no custom applyEffectTick; inherited callback is inert. Cataclysm client constructor registers ClientEvent.ClientEvent(), which registers MovementInputUpdateEvent listener. While local Minecraft player has Curse, keyDown adds2 to forwardImpulse,keyUp subtracts2,keyLeft subtracts2 from leftImpulse,keyRight adds2. Ordinary unit keyboard inputs therefore reverse direction, but code ADDS offsets rather than simply negating arbitrary modded input; diagonal/opposed/custom inputs are distinct future fixtures. It does not alter server mob AI, deal HP or scale by amplifier. This is combat-relevant client control, not just rendering; visual overlay is excluded.

effects.display_name: Void Shard collision, lifecycle and NBT
effects.actual_behavior: Native ThrowableProjectile tick/collision/owner restoration and impact cancellation are reused. canHitEntity excludes ignoreEntity then delegates to parent (active Endermaptera constructor leaves ignoreEntity null). Gravity remains enabled. Block hit stores lastState, delegates to parent, writes hit-displacement velocity and backs position off by normalized displacement*getGravity. onHit delegates first, then server broadcasts event 3 and discards independent of hurt. Save writes inBlockState only when lastState exists; load calls writeBlockState(lastState) into the tag instead of restoring the field. Preserve this literal load asymmetry, not an invented restoration. No terrain break/explosion or custom death/respawner path is added.

effects.display_name: Endermaptera wall attachment and climb motion
effects.actual_behavior: Server chooses DOWN on ground/water/bubble/lava, UP on vertical collision, otherwise the nearest supported loaded horizontal neighbor (initial closest distance 100). Climbing bit derives from horizontal collision or vertical collision while airborne. Non-DOWN horizontal face can add normalized face vector*0.1 when not horizontally colliding; while falling from the old velocity snapshot it halves current Y. If that branch did not flag and onClimbable, old velocity is rewritten with Y*0.4. Preserve sequential writes and old snapshot, not generic knockback.

effects.display_name: Gauntlet of Guard native sustained AABB full-vector pull
effects.actual_behavior: onUseTick uses usingEntity.level(), queries LivingEntity in user bounding box inflated11 in every axis, with no added radial/LOS/owner/team/self exclusion. Only Player with abilities.invulnerable is skipped. For every other recipient, diff=normalize(recipient.position-user.position)*0.1; setDeltaMovement(oldVelocity-diff). Full Y direction is retained; coincident native normalization remains native. This is a per-use-callback velocity contribution, not vanilla knockback: no explicit knockback event/KBR read, no hurt, status, healing, projectile or owner substitution. Movement loop precedes the client-only particle branch and has no local server gate. Native recipient setter/collision/use interruption remain native.

effects.display_name: Ghost Form native immunity/actions and expiry delivery
effects.actual_behavior: Beneficial Ghost Form adds MOVEMENT_SPEED +0.4*(amplifier+1) ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL under cataclysm:ghost_speed. ServerEventHandler cancels LivingIncomingDamageEvent while recipient has Form unless source BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. It also cancels the Player attack event and use-item Start, and sets base use-item event duration0. No Form canAttack mixin, no direct entity NoAI/noPhysics, and no universal prohibition of already-scheduled/direct hurt producers are present in this slice. Rendering transparency is cosmetic. Binary immunity/actions and speed/duration stay native EffectGhostForm.shouldApply stores its argument in the registered effect object lastDuration and returns argument>0. applyEffectTick requests Ghost Sickness7200amp0 with particles=false/icon=true only when stored argument==1. Native finite MobEffectInstance.tick calls shouldApply with remaining duration, immediately calls apply, then decrements, so ordinary100tick Form attempts Sickness on its last tick before expiry. It is not an on-remove callback: early cure/explicit removal does not itself schedule Sickness. For native infinite instances the argument is recipient.tickCount, not remaining duration, so do not generalize to a universal expiry trigger. Normal native tick ordering is pinned; no concurrency effect inferred.

effects.display_name: Ghost Sickness cure set and revival exclusion
effects.actual_behavior: Harmful Ghost Sickness has no damage, movement modifier or resource drain in applyEffectTick (returns true); its combat role is the rebirth presence gate. The50>>amplifier callback cadence does not imply periodic damage. fillEffectCures is empty rather than calling the default extension, so native instances start with no ordinary cure entries. removeEffectsCuredBy requires the cure to exist in that set before the removal event. Thus ordinary cure-based removal is excluded by that mechanism; it is distinct from explicit removeEffect/removeAllEffects. ServerEventHandler.preventEffectRemoval compares effectInstance.getEffect() == ModEffect.EFFECTGHOST_SICKNESS.get(). The first is a Holder; the second is the registered EffectGhost_Sickness MobEffect value, which is not that Holder. Its identity test is false for the native effect instances, so this listener does NOT prevent explicit removal. Patched removeEffect/removeAllEffects still post normal removal events and other listeners can veto. Natural expiry is not prevented by this code. Keep empty cure-set admission and ineffective explicit-removal listener separate; no immunity repair is authorized.

effects.display_name: Guardian predicted Hug and direct air-strike teleports
effects.actual_behavior: Native tick priority is mass phase, air strike, vortex, then Hug and other attacks. Hug requires alive target, AI enabled, NO_ANIMATION, target onGround and teleport cooldown<=0: range4.3..16 inclusive with randomFloat*100<4, or distance<4.3 with threshold0.7. It sets cooldown280; counters decrement later that same tick. Its branch is reached only if the earlier vortex selection does not win. Vortex selection itself requires ready cooldown, AI enabled, NO_ANIMATION, distanceSq<=1024 and either distanceSq>=35 with random<2%, or random<60% with targetY>=GuardianY+3; short-circuit draw ordering remains native. No new LOS gate appears in these Hug predicates. Broader attack selection and all payloads are deferred. Registered HugmeGoal has sensing30/teleport20. start stores targetX/Z. At animation tick14 with target present it predicts floor(currentX+(currentX-startX)/20*30), sameZ, and saves TeleportPos with current targetY. At tick20, target still present and saved pos present -> private teleport(savedX,CURRENT targetY,savedZ). Returned boolean is ignored: a failed/canceled teleport does not cancel the animation. Goal matching uses SimpleAnimationGoal animation reference identity; AnimationGoal requires updates every tick. Private teleport first searches downward from original candidate until blocksMotion/min height; no solid block ->false. Otherwise EventHooks.onEnderTeleport constructs AND posts EntityTeleportEvent.EnderEntity to NeoForge.EVENT_BUS. Cancellation ->false; modified targetXYZ ->ProperTeleport. Helper requires hasChunkAt, searches down for solid below, tentatively teleportTo, then noCollision AND !containsAnyLiquid. Failure restores prior XYZ and returns false; success optionally broadcasts46, stops navigation and returns true. Outer helper emits TELEPORT game event at old position/sound only on success. Keep event-mutated destination and cancellation distinct from collision/liquid rejection. AIR_STRIKE1 normal selection requires alive target, AI enabled, NO_ANIMATION, distanceSq256..1024 inclusive, target onGround, helmetless flagtrue, randomFloat*100<20 and smash cooldown<=0; assigns cooldown600 before later same-tick decrement. Registered TeleportStrikeGoal zeroes XZ velocity before tick40, retaining Y. With target present at tick40 it calls direct teleportTo(targetX,targetY+(helmetless?8:4),targetZ). It does NOT call private teleport, Ender teleport hook, ground search, collision or liquid check at that site. Normal native selector requires helmetless, hence8 is the ordinary path; the helper also contains a4 branch if reached under another native state. At tick>48 and self onGround it sends AIR_STRIKE2 independent of target still being present. No claim that all downstream teleport listeners are bypassed; only the missing helper/event/placement gates at this native site is proven. Landing attack payload remains pending.

effects.display_name: Guardian latched helmet and altar-initialized mass phase
effects.actual_behavior: Synched initialization: IS_HELMETLESS=false, USED_MASS_DESTRUCTION=true, TELEPORT_POS empty. isHelmetless() is a separate live HP<=maxHP/2 predicate. tick first calls super.tick (including eligible shared heal), then while alive and flagfalse and HP<=half, setIsHelmetless(true) and BrokenHelmet. No NoAI guard surrounds this transition. Setter writes armor BASE15/speed BASE0.29 for true,20/0.27 for false, then synced flag. Native modifiers still apply to those bases. It is a latched transition: healing over half does not restore the helmet. Arrow admission changes when the flag changes, not merely when an earlier hit crosses half HP. NBT saves is_Helmetless, used_mass_destruction and optional TeleportPos; load uses the state setters and reads optional position. Loading helmetless true restores attribute bases without calling BrokenHelmet. getBoolean on absent legacy keys supplies false, so missing used_mass_destruction differs from fresh synced defaulttrue; this is an NBT edge fixture, not a recommended artificial spawn setup. Existing shared home persistence remains unchanged. Native registered builder: HP333, attack16, armor20, speed0.27, follow range50, step height1.75, knockback resistance1. Constructor applies health/attack config multipliers (installed file1/1); this is initialization, not healing. CMCommonConfig.Commonbake resolves the fields from CommonConfig. Installed TOML is a pinned file snapshot, not proof of runtime-loaded effective values. The shared drain uses DpsCap/20; a dps_limit_time20 config field is not substituted into that reviewed formula. Shared EFFECTIVE_FOR_BOSSES and NeoForge effect admission continue unchanged; no concrete Guardian canBeAffected override is present in the pinned hierarchy. effects.actual_behavior: Ender_Guardian_Entity.hurt first rejects during GUARDIAN_MASS_DESTRUCTION unless source has BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. Next read DIRECT entity: while getIsHelmetless()==false reject AbstractArrow; reject ShulkerBullet and Ender_Guardian_Bullet_Entity in BOTH helmet states; halve amount for direct AbstractGolem; then call LLibrary_Boss_Monster.hurt with the same source. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY only exempts the first animation gate here: it does not exempt those arrow/bullet predicates or golem reduction. The local post-super branch only plays a sound on hurttrue and helmetless. An owner/causing golem behind a projectile does not satisfy direct AbstractGolem. These are class tests, not a general IS_PROJECTILE damage tag test. After the concrete prefilters, shared hurt calls virtual isInvulnerableTo (Guardian adds exact IN_WALL rejection), then applies the accepted bypass/cap/causing-distance/bucket/native-hurt pipeline. Guardian overrides DamageCap, DpsCap, RangeLimit and NatureRegen using CMCommonConfig.EnderGuardian. Pinned installed common file and static defaults give cap22, drain-rate13/20=0.65 per AI-enabled server tick, range12 with linear falloff12..18 and rejection at>=18, idle heal25 per20ticks when targetless and inherited regen timer<=0; HealCooldown remains inherited200. Only successful add destroys altar and marks spawnedBoss. Ordinary fresh entity construction retains used=true and lacks this altar initialization. Whole installed class scan finds four setter-caller methods: altar spawnMyBoss, mass-goal start, Guardian load and tick. External mods and NBT remain possible inputs. A legitimate future encounter fixture must distinguish actual altar spawn from ordinary fresh spawn; never silently invent the native prerequisite. Alive tick selects GUARDIAN_MASS_DESTRUCTION when AI enabled, animation NO_ANIMATION, used=false and current HP<=half. It does not require a target. Selection alone is not the consumed flag; actual goal start is. Incoming non-bypass immunity lasts for this animation identity, not an inferred subrange. Its attack payload/timings remain R2k3b. A fresh default used=true Guardian can still lose its helmet/explode but does not enter this one-time mass phase via that branch.

Invalid/dead/spectator target creates radius1 NONE explosion+discard, then independent fuse<=0 branch can create another radius1 explosion+discard. Each active tick adds radiusPerTick; if result<.5 discards and returns, otherwise clamps/stores radius. Saves Age,Duration,WaitTime,DurationOnUse,RadiusOnUse,RadiusPerTick,Radius.

effects.display_name: Ignis offensive motion and animation chains
effects.actual_behavior: Priority1 offensive goals claim MOVE/JUMP/LOOK; idle AttackMoveGoal priority2 pursues but has no melee/damage call. Body-check normal writes target displacement*.25 at20, soul*.4F at16, Y0. Air smash writes target XZ displacement*.15,Y1.3 at19 (no target Y1.4) then onGround after19 ->SMASH. Reinforced variants do the same at84 (no target Y1.8), land after84 -> matching normal/soul smash. Horizontal/poke goals add forward*.3*clamped distance (clamps10/15; poke no-target adds unit forward); combo1 adds forward*.35*clamp(distance,0,5) at15/36/71, then target-nonnull at84 ->COMBO2. Predictive uppercut/combo2 snapshot initial targetXZ; before charge27 compute floor(currentXZ+(currentXZ-initialXZ)/27*12), then at27 write displacement*.3F,Y0 and clear target vector; stop also clears it. Uppercut retains target captured at goal start; combo2 rereads current target. Small swings/combo2 add forward1.5 at native ticks, subject to target-distance>3.5 where specified. Forced facing/zeroXZ preserve native windows. Before selection, floatStrider native lava support may setOnGround(true), feeding the air-smash landing gate; otherwise velocity is halved plus randomFloat*.5Y. Native canStandOnFluid accepts lava, with fluid affected/push overrides false. tick also calls the locked native repelEntities(1.4F,4F,1.4F,1.4F); its helper and native target pushes are reused, not new damage.

effects.actual_behavior: Altar useItemOn, without local server guard, accepts a non-shifting Player held item other than the altar block item; empty slot receives a copy count1 and noncreative inventory shrinks1. Occupied slot ejects its copy and clears instead; placement itself is not restricted to a sacrifice. Native block tick has no side gate. tick tests nonempty slot0 exact ABYSSAL_SACRIFICE, then summoningticks>121 first calls BlockBreaking(3,6,3) and EntityType.create(level), both before ServerLevel/non-null spawn guard. Clearance scans floor(float(blockPos)) + XZ[-3,3], Y[0,6]; skips the exact default AIR state reference and ALTAR_DESTROY_IMMUNE, then native destroyBlock(pos,false) with no explicit actor/grief/destroy hook/side gate here. The pinned tag protects the altar itself. Server spawn sets XZ float(pos)+.5/Y+3 and current-dimension altar GlobalPos home, then addFreshEntity. Only true add empties sacrifice, marks changed and notifies; no explicit finalizeSpawn, persistence flag, phase setter, water test or altar removal. Failed add keeps item/counter and retries on later eligible ticks. Counter updates after this branch: !summoning resets0, otherwise increments; cleared item is noticed next tick. Native inventory NBT load/save only; countdown/summoning/chomp state unsaved. Waterlogged block defaultfalse/placement tests vanilla WATER, not a summoning prerequisite; altar water state is distinct from Leviathan eye-fluid admission.

effects.display_name: Cursed tombstone Maledictus activation, spawn/home and native retry prerequisites
effects.actual_behavior: Cursed_Tombstone_Block defaults FACING=NORTH/LIT=false/POWERED=false. Its native ticker connects the exact Cursed_tombstone_Entity.commonTick on both sides. While unpowered, cooldownProgress increments until installed CursedTombstoneCooldown1*1200, then a later tick sets POWERED=true. useItemOn requires POWERED AND !LIT, writes LITtrue and returnsSUCCESS; it neither tests nor consumes a specific item and has no local side guard. Powered+lit increments tickCount; tickCount>63 creates native MALEDICTUS before checking ServerLevel/non-null. Server spawn sets position(x+.5,y+2,z+.5), writes block FACING, sets Home=current dimension/tombstone pos, then finalizeSpawn(SPAWNER) overwrites directionSOUTH and initializes shared homeTicks400. It clears offsets X/Z=-1..1,Y=0..5 before addFreshEntity, skipping AIR.defaultBlockState and cataclysm:altar_destroy_immune, using destroyBlock(false) with no local mobGriefing gate. Only addFreshEntity=true triggers final tombstone destroyBlock(false). No attack state, persistence-required flag or target write is added. The branch does not reset tickCount after a failed create/add; if the lit tombstone remains, later eligible ticks retry. Powered+unlit resets tickCount0. Block entity saves only cooldownProgress with putInt; load tests contains("summonCooldownProgress",11) then getInt, so the ordinary saved int does not round-trip through that exact-type admission. tickCount is unsaved. Existing block state persistence and native creation/finalization/add/block hooks remain native.

effects.actual_behavior: Goal canUse requires a current alive target; continue only requires a non-null current target. Start enters CIRCLE, selects 120+nextInt(40) circle ticks, radius 8+nextInt(4), random direction and aggression. Circle helper computes t=direction*frame*0.5*speed/radius+offset and navigates to target+(radius*cos(t),0,radius*sin(t)) at speed*moveSpeedMultiplier (both 1 here). Circle expires or linear target distance <5 enters MELEE. Melee navigates at 1, faces target at 30/30, restarts at 120 ticks, otherwise squared distance <=4 and NO_ANIMATION selects the 11-tick bite. Stop randomizes/reset mode state, clears unsuitable creative/spectator target and stops navigation. No explicit local sitting/tame/LOS or team gate is added to this goal.

effects.display_name: Scylla shared spear motion, impact and deflection
effects.actual_behavior: Finite Elemental_Spear base: on client or owner null/notRemoved plus loaded chunk -> parent tick and private lifetime++; collider clip plus native ProjectileImpact cancellation before hitTargetOrDeflectSelf. Then checkInsideBlocks, move to oldPos+oldVelocity, velocity=(oldVelocity+normalize(oldVelocity)*accelerationPower)*native inertia. Constructors keep accelerationPower.1 separately from initial speed. Water inertia float(.95), lightning float(.98). On hit redirects REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE with AIM_DEFLECT and original owner; deflection calls parent then changes acceleration to.1 for player or halves otherwise. Entity hit does not inherently discard either spear.
